subject: Stakeholder alignment & launch readiness: MAP finalization
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@soteria.bio>, Omar Ruiz <omar.ruiz@soteria.bio>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps after today — stakeholder alignment and MAP draft

Hi Claire / Omar —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for launch readiness. I’ve attached the working Mutual Action Plan (MAP_DRAFT_v2.pdf) and the initial SOW (SOW_v1.docx).

High-level milestones (proposed):
- Week of 8/30: Finalize MAP milestones and responsibilities (owner: Soteria / Redwood)
- 9/1–9/10: Security evidence exchange & SOC2 comments (owner: Soteria security, Redwood security)
- 9/3–9/14: Legal redlines and SOW agreement (owner: Soteria legal, Redwood legal)
- 9/15: Executive signature target (tie to procurement clearance)
- 10/1: Target go-live (pilot in production, limited internal users)

Key responsibilities (summary):
- Soteria: procurement approval, legal sign-off, test dataset for acceptance cases, security checklist confirmation
- Redwood: deployment plan, performance acceptance criteria (latency/throughput), monitoring playbook, final DocuSign package

Dependencies / open items:
1) Procurement timeline/PO process from Omar (procurement) — we need anticipated PO lead time and any required PO language.
2) Security artifacts — we attached a security evidence summary; please flag any gaps.
3) Any non-standard contract terms that legal needs to surface.

Target close date: we recommend aiming for 2026-09-15 for signatures to keep engineering/ops schedule intact. If that doesn't work, let us know the preferred close window and we’ll adjust milestones.

Ask: Please review the MAP_DRAFT_v2.pdf and SOW_v1.docx and reply with any redlines or approval by EOD 9/3. If Soteria is comfortable with the milestones above, confirm ownerships and we’ll generate a final SOW for signature.

Attachments: MAP_DRAFT_v2.pdf, SOW_v1.docx, security_evidence_summary.pdf

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | (555) 867-4021

--
Redwood Inference | Production-first LLM inference
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@soteria.bio>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Omar Ruiz <omar.ruiz@soteria.bio>, Soteria Biotech Legal <legal@soteria.bio>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps after today — stakeholder alignment and MAP draft

Hi Priya / team —

Thanks for the clear recap and the documents — useful. Quick responses from our side:

- MAP: high level items look good. We’ll confirm owners internally but Claire (product) will own acceptance testing and Omar (procurement) will own the PO process.
- Security evidence: our security team will review the attached summary tonight and will come back with any gaps by 9/2.
- Legal redlines: we plan to have our counsel start review the SOW next week.

One ask: procurement has a couple of internal quarterly budget freezes coming up. Can we shift the target signature date to 2026-09-22 instead of 9/15? That gives us one more week to get approvals. If that shift impacts your go-live target, flag it.

We’re generally aligned with the proposed responsibilities. Omar — I’ll kick off the internal procurement timeline and share expected PO lead time by Tuesday.

Claire Jensen
Head of Product, Soteria Biotech
claire.jensen@soteria.bio

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the quick feedback and for flagging procurement timing. Shifting the signature target to 2026-09-22 is workable from our side; two notes:

1) Impact to go-live — moving the signature to 9/22 would likely shift our target go-live from 10/1 to 10/8 to preserve the planned validation window. Is that acceptable?
2) Security artifacts — to keep momentum, could you share the first-pass gaps by 9/2 as planned. We’ll assign Redwood security to respond within two business days.

Next steps on our side:
- I’m attaching SOW_v1_with_comments.docx with a few clarifying items for legal to pre-review (minor commercial language, acceptance criteria clarifications).
- If procurement confirms PO lead time this week, we’ll queue the DocuSign bundle and put the exec signature step on our calendar.

For transparency: Marissa is standing by to review discount/credits if procurement requests rate adjustments tied to contract term. Karthik — looping you for any final pricing gestures/approval.

Attachments: SOW_v1_with_comments.docx

Thanks —
Priya

Priya / Karthik —

Quick internal note after reviewing the call recap + SOW comments:
- Soteria is asking to move signature to 9/22. That’s reasonable.
- Procurement often asks for a modest term discount in exchange for an earlier multi-quarter commit. If they push on price, I’m comfortable offering a 7.5% credit for a 12-month commit; need your sign-off Karthik.
- If legal flags any unusual indemnity language, escalate to me and I’ll triage with product/legal.

If we’re aligned on the credit guideline, I’ll prepare a commercial addendum to attach to the final DocuSign packet.
